meta.name: acquiring-disk-image-with-dd-and-dcfldd
meta.description: Create forensically sound bit-for-bit disk images using dd and dcfldd while preserving evidence integrity through hash verification.

copy.tagline: 创建法证级磁盘镜像并验证哈希完整性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作可被法庭采信的磁盘副本
copy.tagline_en: Create forensically sound disk images with hash verification
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create court-admissible disk copies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能指导你使用 dd 或 dcfldd 工具创建硬盘、U盘等存储设备的逐位精确副本，并自动计算哈希值验证镜像完整性，生成取证报告。
howto.when: 当你需要制作用于数字取证或法律调查的磁盘镜像，或要求对存储设备进行逐位复制并验证完整性时触发。

say.text: 如何验证我刚刚制作的磁盘镜像与源盘一致？
say.note: Claude 会提供哈希比对命令。

say.text: 我需要将一块 500GB 硬盘的镜像分割成 2GB 的文件。
say.note: Claude 会给出 split 参数用法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you to create bit-for-bit disk images of storage devices like hard drives and USB drives using dd or dcfldd, automatically compute hash values to verify image integrity, and generate forensic reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a forensic disk image for digital investigation or legal proceedings, or when you request a bit-for-bit copy with integrity verification.

say_en.text: Help me create a disk image of /dev/sdb with SHA-256 hash using dcfldd.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the full dcfldd command and steps.

say_en.text: How do I verify that the disk image matches the source?
say_en.note: Claude will provide hash comparison commands.

say_en.text: I need to split a 500GB hard drive image into 2GB files.
say_en.note: Claude will show the split parameter usage.
